summary.executive_summary: Demo data: vulnbank has critical SQL injection and command injection. The SQL injection fix was proven in Docker.
key_recommendations: Enforce object ownership checks on invoices
Normalise and confine file download paths
summary.note: Demo data. Scanners contributed 11 findings, the Logic Auditor 2; the five most important are listed.

vulnerabilities.description: The /search route concatenates the q parameter into a SQL string, allowing arbitrary queries.
/invoices/<id> returns any invoice without checking that it belongs to the signed-in user.
/download joins a user-supplied filename onto the exports directory without normalising it.
A secret key is committed in source.
The admin ping tool passes the host field to a shell.

patch.rationale: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query and validate the input length.
patch.diff:
--- a/app.py
+++ b/app.py
@@ -110,5 +110,6 @@
 def search():
     q = request.args.get('q', '')
-    rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%" + q + "%'").fetchall()
+    q = q[:100]
+    rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM products WHERE name LIKE ?", (f'%{q}%',)).fetchall()
     return render_template('search.html', rows=rows)
